Class AsiContainerUpgrade

java.lang.Object
uno.anahata.asi.AsiContainerUpgrade
public class AsiContainerUpgrade extends Object
Service orchestrator for discovering predecessor ASI container installations and migrating persistent settings.

Evaluates sibling version directories in the host application working directory (e.g. ~/.anahata/asi/netbeans/), identifies genuine prior container directories while ignoring non-version folders (like screenshots or scratch), and migrates serialized *.kryo provider configurations, templates, and sessions.

Author:
anahata

  • Method Details

    • isContainerDirectory

      public static boolean isContainerDirectory(Path dir)
      Checks if a directory is a genuine Anahata ASI container directory holding settings.

      A directory is recognized as an ASI container if it contains an anahata.asi.properties metadata file, or (as a legacy fallback for pre-1.2.0 versions) if it contains a providers, templates, or sessions subdirectory containing at least one *.kryo entity file.

      Parameters:
      dir - The candidate directory path to inspect.
      Returns:
      true if the directory contains ASI container data, false otherwise.

    • findPredecessor

      public static Optional<Path> findPredecessor(Path baseDir, Version currentVersion)
      Scans the base host application directory for predecessor version directories older than the running version.

      Only considers directories whose names parse to a valid Version, are strictly older than currentVersion, and contain genuine container settings (verified via isContainerDirectory(Path)). Returns the highest predecessor version directory found.

      Parameters:
      baseDir - The parent host application directory (e.g. ~/.anahata/asi/netbeans/).
      currentVersion - The active container version to compare against.
      Returns:
      An Optional containing the path to the immediate predecessor container directory, or empty if none found.

    • copySettings

      public static int copySettings(Path sourceDir, Path targetDir) throws IOException
      Migrates persistent settings from a source predecessor container directory to the target container directory.

      Copies all *.kryo files from providers/, templates/, and sessions/ (including sessions/saved/ if present).

      Parameters:
      sourceDir - The predecessor container directory.
      targetDir - The destination container directory.
      Returns:
      The total number of entity files migrated.
      Throws:
      IOException - If copying files fails.
